usageNotes: Removes a storage definition from the cluster-wide storage configuration. This is a synchronous operation — it returns null immediately, not a task UPID. It only deletes the configuration entry; any data on the underlying storage (disks, datasets, directories) is left untouched. Requires the Datastore.Allocate privilege on the /storage path.

examples.summary: Delete an NFS storage definition named 'nfs-backup'

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named storage pool from the Proxmox cluster configuration; any VMs or backups referencing this storage ID will lose access to their configured paths until the storage is re-added.
tips: Verify no VMs or CT have disks, backups, or ISOs referencing this storage ID before deleting — Proxmox does not block removal even if resources are still assigned.
The operation is cluster-wide; removing the storage here removes it from all nodes that share the cluster config.
If you need to temporarily disable a storage pool without losing the config, use the update endpoint to set 'disable: 1' instead.
